description: Rules for requesting a free subdomain of omnexlab.site. The server-side checks are the source of truth; these are published so tools can pre-check a request.

record.note: Only a CNAME to a supported host is allowed.

notes: no two hyphens in a row
must not start or end with a hyphen

blockedWordsNote: Names containing any of these words are refused to prevent impersonation.

supportedHosts.note: For verified hosts the name must already be attached to the project at the host before requesting; otherwise the request is refused. Other hosts are accepted but cannot be verified, so attach the name there immediately.

trafficModes.description: Through Cloudflare: instant HTTPS. HTTPS is decrypted at Cloudflare before reaching your host.
Direct to your host (DNS only): HTTPS terminates at your own host. Choose this for anything sensitive.

notForSensitiveUse: Do not use free shared subdomains for logins, private data or payments.

how.issueBodyFormat:
### What do you want to do?

Create a new subdomain

### Subdomain name

<name>

### Where your site lives (address only)

<host address, e.g. myproject.vercel.app>

### Traffic mode

Through Cloudflare (instant HTTPS, recommended for public sites)
how.note: The requester is the GitHub account that opens the issue. Add the name to your host first.
